label: third original token after a sequence starting [m/z/1/0/h] j
explanation: Fires only in the original phase, almost entirely at t=2 (93% of mass) when the second input was j and the first was m, z, 1, 0 or h. It is strongest for m j (all top examples are m j followed by 2, at max activation), and an input of 2 at step 2 also gives larger activations. A weaker tail (7% of mass) fires at t=3 when the previous token is j and the token before it is m/z/1/0. It never fires at the delimiter or during the copy phase, or when the previous token is not j (97% of mass has prev_tok=j). h j is the least reliable prefix and accounts for most false positives. Dev: precision 0.95, recall 0.68, F1 0.79, mass recall 0.84; most of the missed recall is low-activation firing with other prefixes (x j, j j, f j) and the t=3 tail.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: t=2 & prev_tok=j (+8.09), prev2_tok=m (+5.76), prev_tok=j (+4.66), prev2_tok=z (+4.21), prev2_tok=1 (+4.10), prev2_tok=h (+3.57). Lower it: correct=1 (-7.25), orig_idx=-1 (-2.85), orig0=k (-1.48), orig2=v (-1.43).
